skills.name: Enhanced Optics
skills.description: " Tower range is increased by X% . " Boosts tower range by 0.5% for each purchase. Has a base cost of 6 with an exponential value of 1.73.

skills.name: Improved Gunpowder
skills.description: " AOE explosion radius is increased by X% . " AOE explosion radius of towers is increased by 0.5% for each purchase. There is a requirement of reaching Level 10 in Enhanced Optics before it is unlocked. Has a base cost of 5 with an exponential value of 1.725.

skills.name: Fight Dirty
skills.description: " Debuff durations applied to enemies are increased by X% . " Tower debuffs, such as stun, shock, freeze, burn, poison, confusion or chill are longer by 1% for each purchase. There is a requirement of reaching Level 10 in Improved Gunpowder before it is unlocked. Has a base cost of 5 with an exponential value of 1.77.

skills.name: Precision
skills.description: " Every X Enemies shots, a tower deals a critical hit (1.25x damage). Cannot stack with other critical hit towers. " Every 29th tower shot will be a critical hit that deals 1.25x damage, with the number of shots decreasing by 1 with each upgrade. There is a requirement of reaching Level 10 in Fight Dirty before it is unlocked. Has a base cost of 7 with an exponential value of 2.035.

skills.name: Resourcefulness
skills.description: " Selling towers returns x% more money. " Tower sell cost returns 1.2% more money every purchase. With the base sell cost, it is ~34.53% sell cost at Level 1. Has a base cost of 4 with an exponential value of 1.75.

skills.name: Bigger Budget
skills.description: " Starting cash is increased by X% . " Starting cash is increased by 1% for each purchase. There is a requirement of reaching Level 10 in Resourcefulness before it is unlocked. Has a base cost of 4 with an exponential value of 1.82.

skills.name: Stonks
skills.description: " Wave rewards are increased by X% . " Wave bonus is higher by 0.5% for each purchase by adding it to the match wave bonus multiplier. Wave clear bonus is also affected, as it is a percentage of the wave bonus. There is a requirement of reaching Level 10 in Bigger Budget before it is unlocked. Has a base cost of 7 with an exponential value of 1.78.

skills.name: Scavenger
skills.description: " Every X Enemies kills grant 1.5x rewards from enemies. " Reward from killing enemies is boosted by 1.5x every 29th kill. Decreases by 1 with each upgrade. There is a requirement of reaching Level 10 in Stonks before it is unlocked. Has a base cost of 7 with an exponential value of 1.865.

skills.name: Accelerator
skills.description: " Reduces cooldowns of active abilities by X% . " Reduces tower ability cooldowns by 0.5% for each purchase. Does not affect initial cooldowns of towers. Has a base cost of 4 with an exponential value of 1.77.

skills.name: Scholar
skills.description: " Logbook drop rate increases by X . " Multiplies the chance to drop Logbooks by 1.01, increasing by 0.01 for each purchase. There is a requirement of reaching Level 10 in Accelerator before it is unlocked. Has a base cost of 5 with an exponential value of 1.83.

skills.name: Expanded Barracks
skills.description: " Cooldown for spawning units is reduced by X% . " Reduces tower's spawnrate by 0.75% for each purchase. There is a requirement of reaching Level 10 in Accelerator before it is unlocked. Has a base cost of 6 with an exponential value of 1.86.

skills.name: Re-enforcements
skills.description: " Increases the tower placement limit by X . (Scales with number of players). " Increases placement limit for the player by 1 for each purchase. In matches with more players, the limit will scale. In duo, it is 0.8 rather than 1 per purchase, while in trio and higher it is 0.5 per purchase. There is a requirement of reaching Level 10 in Expanded Barracks before it is unlocked. Has a base cost of 100 with an exponential value of 1.5.

skills.name: Fortify
skills.description: " Increases the player's health pool by X . (In groups, the highest HP is used.) " Increases the maximum base health by 5 for each purchase. In duo+, the highest base health is chosen. Has a base cost of 3 with an exponential value of 1.4.

skills.name: Over-Heal
skills.description: " Increases how much extra HP can be kept from over-healing by X . " Increases amount of health kept per player from over-healing by 8 for every purchase. There is a requirement of reaching Level 10 in Fortify before it is unlocked. Has a base cost of 5 with an exponential value of 1.7.

skills.name: Bandages
skills.description: " Regenerates X health at the start of every wave. " Heals the base health per player by 1 for each purchase. There is a requirement of reaching Level 10 in Over-Heal before it is unlocked. Has a base cost of 5 with an exponential value of 1.7.

skills.name: Extreme Conditioning
skills.description: " Reduces stun and debuff durations from enemies by X% . " Reduces tower stun and debuff durations from enemies by 0.8% for each purchase. There is a requirement of reaching Level 10 in Bandages before it is unlocked. Has a base cost of 5 with an exponential value of 1.725.

skills.name: Beefed Up Minions
skills.description: " Health of summoned units is increased by X% . " Increases unit's health by 0.6% for each purchase. Only applies to units summoned by towers, units summoned through other sources, like consumables, are not affected. There is a requirement of reaching Level 10 in Extreme Conditioning before it is unlocked. Has a base cost of 6 with an exponential value of 1.68.
